about: The Workbench icons of the Gigalomania drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/gigalomania.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/gigalomania.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Gigalomania-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Gigalomania.info beside the drawer; gigalomania.info is the program's. ReadMe.info is also copied for readme.html, COPYING.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of gfx, sound, music, islands and User.
